title: Yahoo breach cold open

visual_description: Black title card stating Yahoo reported the largest data breach in history; digital lock imagery follows.

title: Breach scale and attack imagery
visual_description: News-style Yahoo breach visual followed by terminal/code and device imagery.
purpose: Move from headline to data-security context

title: Everyday data systems
visual_description: Phone use, laptop typing, city/business footage.
purpose: Transition from breach story into how digital information is stored and used

title: Database concept bridge
visual_description: Calculator, laptop entry, handshake/business and office visuals; includes DaVinci Fusion title sections.

title: Finding information and queries
visual_description: Laptop/office imagery introducing retrieval of stored information.

title: Yahoo login query example
visual_description: Typing and office/data-use imagery leading into larger shared-system visuals.
purpose: Explain a query using a Yahoo login example

title: Concurrent use
visual_description: City pedestrian traffic, busy office and dashboard/business footage; on-screen CONCURRENT USE label appears.

title: Scalability
visual_description: City growth, construction and large-building imagery; SCALABILITY label appears.
purpose: Explain growth from thousands to millions or billions of records

title: Permissions and access
visual_description: Network/cable imagery, fingerprint/security imagery and black title card reading WHO CAN SEE YOUR DATA?.

title: Yahoo 2013 unauthorized access
purpose: Explain unauthorized access and the scale of the Yahoo breach

title: From one breach to combined breach data

title: MOAB and 26 billion records

purpose: Introduce Mother of All Breaches and clarify scale

title: What billions of records mean
visual_description: People using computers, organizational/server imagery and work environments.
purpose: Explain that one person can appear in many records

title: Useful databases and dangerous stolen data
visual_description: Business teams, code, transactions/money and consumer-use imagery.
purpose: Contrast normal database usefulness with risks

title: Lesson about scale

title: Final login-box close
